readme: UI Review sections (open registry). Add a kind here, or in kinds.json in the plugin's data folder, and it shows as its own section; an item submitted with a kind nobody listed still gets a section of its own (label made from its id). Order sorts the sections.

kinds.label: Design packs
kinds.desc: Candidate design packages for the look refactor. Pick up to 3.

kinds.label: Whole apps / programs
kinds.desc: A new or reworked app, end to end.

kinds.label: Screens & pages
kinds.desc: One page or screen of an app or plugin.

kinds.label: Settings interfaces
kinds.desc: Settings pages, plugin settings tabs, level editors.

kinds.label: Banners & cards
kinds.desc: Banners, banner badges, Home cards, widgets.

kinds.label: Other
kinds.desc: Anything that fits no other section.
